BackstoryDef.title: marble hall child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up under glowing stones in a city where slaves washed the floor before anyone woke. For a long time [PAWN_pronoun] assumed floors simply were clean.

BackstoryDef.title: slave pen runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] family ran pens outside Vilverin. [PAWN_nameDef] carried keys and messages through them from the age of six, and no one thought anything of it.

BackstoryDef.title: well keeper's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held the lamp while [PAWN_possessive] parent gathered starlight at the Ayleid well, and picked up the words to the hymn before [PAWN_pronoun] knew they meant anything.

BackstoryDef.title: flower page
BackstoryDef.description: At the royal court, pages scatter flowers before the king and pray they have picked the right ones. [PAWN_nameDef] once picked the wrong ones and has never told anyone what happened.

BackstoryDef.title: mason's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] played on half-built vaults and knew a good keystone from a bad one by the sound it made when kicked.

BackstoryDef.title: Alessia's orphan
BackstoryDef.description: The rebels burned [PAWN_nameDef]'s city when [PAWN_pronoun] was young. A human soldier once looked straight at [PAWN_objective] and walked on. [PAWN_pronoun] has not yet decided how to feel about that.

BackstoryDef.title: star pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Someone noticed that [PAWN_nameDef] could draw the sky from memory. After that there were tutors, then rooftop nights, and then no one asked [PAWN_objective] what [PAWN_pronoun] wanted anymore.

BackstoryDef.title: altar child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] house kept a shrine to Molag Bal. [PAWN_nameDef] learned at an early age to hold very still during the service.

BackstoryDef.title: marble guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood in a white and gold harness on the palace stair. Guards there are expected to look pretty and kill without changing expression.

BackstoryDef.title: slave catcher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode the Nibenay valley after runaways with hounds and a list. In the end the runaways came back with an army.

BackstoryDef.title: Sancre Tor defender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was at Sancre Tor when the Nords and the slave armies came up the walls. Most people learn not to ask [PAWN_objective] about it.

BackstoryDef.title: tower archer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loosed from high slits in a white tower for most of a life. Few enemies ever got close enough to learn [PAWN_possessive] face.

BackstoryDef.title: Umaril's retainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served the Unfeathered through the campaign against the Alessians, and saw him fall to Pelinal. [PAWN_pronoun] also saw him come back, and prefers not to discuss either.

BackstoryDef.title: Black Marsh exile
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fled the Diaspora toward Black Marsh and was turned back at spearpoint by the Barsaebic Ayleids, who had got there first and didn't want the company.

BackstoryDef.title: Daedra-sworn blade
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] gave a certain oath for a certain sword. The sword has been excellent. The other side of the deal has not come due yet.

BackstoryDef.title: Welkynd cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Starlight has to be caught in something. [PAWN_nameDef] shaped meteoric glass for the sorcerers, losing a little eyesight with each stone.

BackstoryDef.title: Varla binder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made Varla stones, and knew exactly what kind of work the courts wanted them for. The money made that fairly easy to overlook.

BackstoryDef.title: court astrologer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] read the stars for a king who preferred good news. [PAWN_pronoun] survived by telling him the truth on days when he was too drunk to notice.

BackstoryDef.title: Daedra caller
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] called up scamps for a noble house's parties. The trick, as with most things in a Flower Court, was making sure someone else was blamed afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: vault necromancer
BackstoryDef.description: The city's dead were expected to keep working. [PAWN_nameDef] saw to that from a cold room under the palace, and it never struck [PAWN_objective] as odd.

BackstoryDef.title: sky cartographer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] corrected the old sky charts, adding the stars that had moved and noting the one that had not been there before.

BackstoryDef.title: vault architect
BackstoryDef.description: No mortar, a single keystone and a ceiling thirty paces up: [PAWN_nameDef] took pride in saying the vault would outlast the city, and it has.

BackstoryDef.title: slave factor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bought and sold people in Sedor and kept tidy records of it. There is a copy of those records in the hands of someone [PAWN_pronoun] would very much like to find.

BackstoryDef.title: flower garden keeper
BackstoryDef.description: The Flower Kings named themselves for something, and [PAWN_nameDef] grew it, in white terraces, using a great many hands other than [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: palace cook
BackstoryDef.description: Nothing in a palace kitchen goes as simply as a meal. [PAWN_nameDef] cooked, tasted everything first, and took note of who else was tasting.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb sculptor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carved the faces of lords onto their tombs and improved all of them. Nobody has ever complained, and that is the main advantage of the work.

BackstoryDef.title: Diaspora smuggler
BackstoryDef.description: As the cities fell, [PAWN_nameDef] moved elves and their relics out to the Direnni in High Rock, for prices that went up each month. [PAWN_pronoun] is not ashamed of this.

BackstoryDef.title: ruined noble
BackstoryDef.description: Once [PAWN_nameDef] owned forty slaves. Then the tower fell, and now [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to do [PAWN_possessive] own laundry, and resents it daily.

BackstoryDef.title: White-Gold stair child
BackstoryDef.description: White-Gold Tower has more steps than any child could count, and [PAWN_nameDef] was told to wash them. Lessons in humility came free with the bucket.

BackstoryDef.title: Vilverin water-page
BackstoryDef.description: Vilverin's halls ran down below Lake Rumare, and the lords liked fresh water served in silver. [PAWN_nameDef] carried it from the upper wells and spilled only a little.

BackstoryDef.title: Sedor garden child
BackstoryDef.description: Flowers of Sedor were planted in the shape of constellations. [PAWN_nameDef] knelt for hours to make sure the right ones bloomed in the right order.

BackstoryDef.title: Lindai lamp child
BackstoryDef.description: Welkynd stones need no oil, but the brackets do need polishing. [PAWN_nameDef] went from room to room at Lindai and learned which stones hummed and which ones didn't.

BackstoryDef.title: Nornalhorst pool child
BackstoryDef.description: Nornalhorst's sacred pools kept their heat long into winter. [PAWN_nameDef] raked them clean and was told never to ask what had been dropped in.

BackstoryDef.title: Ceyatatar mason's child
BackstoryDef.description: White stone comes out of the quarry as dull gray, and the shine takes years of work. [PAWN_nameDef] rubbed it with sand until both hands bled and then got a second rag.

BackstoryDef.title: Malada bone sorter
BackstoryDef.description: Many things were kept in the lower chambers of Malada, and not all had been fully dead for long. [PAWN_nameDef] got sent down to sort them and did not sleep well after.

BackstoryDef.title: Aurbic catechism pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Elements come in four kinds, and light is the fifth and greatest. [PAWN_nameDef] recited this every morning until the words stopped making any sense at all.

BackstoryDef.title: Meridia's chorister
BackstoryDef.description: Meridia's worshippers in the old cities sang to her dawn. [PAWN_nameDef] was a high voice in the back row, chosen for tone and not for piety.

BackstoryDef.title: Molag Bal's page
BackstoryDef.description: Some of the houses of Nenalata served worse gods than Meridia. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up carrying goblets in a place where it was very unwise to ask what was in them.

BackstoryDef.title: Star Gallery sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: Under each great city, a gallery was open to the night sky. [PAWN_nameDef] swept the floor and learned the patterns, as nobody thought to stop a sweeper from looking up.

BackstoryDef.title: highborn's sibling
BackstoryDef.description: The heir got the name, the tutor and the good room. [PAWN_nameDef] got the rest of the household's attention and made use of it.

BackstoryDef.title: slave-born half-blood
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in the household would say who [PAWN_nameDef]'s father had been, though everybody knew. The child grew up pale and hungry, with a foot in both worlds.

BackstoryDef.title: flesh-garden child
BackstoryDef.description: Slaves in that house had been grown and pruned and grafted into arrangements. [PAWN_nameDef] was told it was art and was given a small pair of shears.

BackstoryDef.title: Rebellion orphan
BackstoryDef.description: Alessia's army reached the valley in the spring, and the family's lands burned by summer. [PAWN_nameDef] was carried west by a servant who probably should have left the child behind.

BackstoryDef.title: last-winter child
BackstoryDef.description: The city was falling and everyone knew it. Meals got thinner, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned how to make soup out of what had once been a fine garden.

BackstoryDef.title: Valenwood-bound refugee
BackstoryDef.description: The surviving families made it to Valenwood with what they could carry. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among Bosmer who laughed at their manners and helped them anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: High Rock exile child
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid lords in High Rock were still lords, at least in their own halls. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up speaking the old tongue indoors and something else outside.

BackstoryDef.title: Barsaebic novice
BackstoryDef.description: In the western lands, the Barsaebic houses kept to Daedra-free worship, and were proud of it. [PAWN_nameDef] learned the distinction and was told to mention it often.

BackstoryDef.title: Niben river child
BackstoryDef.description: Boats on the Niben brought tribute to the upriver cities. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up fishing from the white quay and looking down at the slaves working the oars.

BackstoryDef.title: varla stone carrier
BackstoryDef.description: Varla stones are heavier than they look and they make your teeth ache. [PAWN_nameDef] carried them up the shaft, wrapped in cloth, and was warned not to drop one.

BackstoryDef.title: Ayleid well keeper's aide
BackstoryDef.description: Great stone wells hummed along the old roads, and they drank power from the stars. [PAWN_nameDef] oiled the caps and kept the sheep off.

BackstoryDef.title: dancing pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Court dances ran six hours and had as many rules as a treaty. [PAWN_nameDef] could perform them flawlessly at nine and was deeply bored at ten.

BackstoryDef.title: kennel slave's friend
BackstoryDef.description: Hounds at the great house were very well fed, and so was the Nedic slave who kept them. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long days in the kennels and heard a lot of forbidden songs.

BackstoryDef.title: lesser cousin
BackstoryDef.description: All Ayleid families have a cousin who eats at the second table. [PAWN_nameDef] sat there, waiting and watching those who sat at the first.

BackstoryDef.title: torch-bearer of the Tower
BackstoryDef.description: At the great festivals, a row of children walked up White-Gold with burning torches. [PAWN_nameDef] walked in the very middle and got wax all down the good robes.

BackstoryDef.title: silver-spoon thief
BackstoryDef.description: Silver spoons were counted at the close of each banquet, a rule made in part for [PAWN_nameDef]. Slave children got blamed instead, which started to bother [PAWN_objective] later.

BackstoryDef.title: fountain builder's child
BackstoryDef.description: A fountain with no moving parts is a kind of very slow spell. [PAWN_nameDef] helped set the stones, and once got a stern look from one for doing it wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: court astronomer's page
BackstoryDef.description: Instruments at the top of the tower needed someone small enough to reach the inner dials. [PAWN_nameDef] came to know the night sky by way of its gears and shadows.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian frontier child
BackstoryDef.description: The farther west an Ayleid family lived, the more they were sneered at back in the Heartland. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the frontier, tough, and shooting at Nedes.

BackstoryDef.title: sewer child of Sancre Tor
BackstoryDef.description: Water at Sancre Tor ran down through stone tunnels, and not all the children who went in had been sent. [PAWN_nameDef] came to know those tunnels better than any guard.

BackstoryDef.title: embroidery pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Every Ayleid robe tells a story in thread, usually about the wearer's ancestors. [PAWN_nameDef] sewed a very flattering one on a very dull uncle at age eight.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb-candle child
BackstoryDef.description: Family tombs were visited on set days and had to be ready in time. [PAWN_nameDef] went ahead to light the lamps and say something polite to the older relatives.

BackstoryDef.title: Nedic nurse's charge
BackstoryDef.description: Each Ayleid child had a Nedic nurse and was told not to get too fond. [PAWN_nameDef] did, and the nurse was sold on anyway when the child turned six.

BackstoryDef.title: cat-keeper
BackstoryDef.description: White cats wandered the courts of Lindai and were treated rather better than most people. [PAWN_nameDef] brushed them for a living, and was bitten by all of the best ones.

BackstoryDef.title: Pelinal's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] was small, a very large man in strange armor walked through the city and everyone in the household died. That's the entire memory, and it's more than enough.

BackstoryDef.title: bronze mirror polisher
BackstoryDef.description: Mirrors at the great house lined a long hall, designed so that lords could see themselves coming. [PAWN_nameDef] had to clean them before the morning's parade.

BackstoryDef.title: rain-channel child
BackstoryDef.description: The city's rain came down in channels of carved white stone. [PAWN_nameDef] went along them with a stick and cleared the leaves when the storms were past.

BackstoryDef.title: ruined-tower child
BackstoryDef.description: Long after the fall, [PAWN_nameDef]'s family was still living in the top of a broken tower. Everything they had was dug up from the floors below.

BackstoryDef.title: hidden-valley child
BackstoryDef.description: A few Ayleids survived in a valley no one had any reason to enter. [PAWN_nameDef] was told that the world outside had ended, and half believed it for years.

BackstoryDef.title: poet's scribe
BackstoryDef.description: A very old relative dictated very long verses to [PAWN_nameDef] about a dead city. Nobody else read them, but the child's spelling became extremely good.

BackstoryDef.title: meadow-hunting page
BackstoryDef.description: A lord's hunt was preceded by a line of children beating the grass. [PAWN_nameDef] walked in that line and noticed that the game was not always animal.

BackstoryDef.title: White-Gold guardsman
BackstoryDef.description: Guards at White-Gold wore enough silver to buy a small town, and they rarely fought. [PAWN_nameDef] did a little fighting there, right at the end, and it was very short.

BackstoryDef.title: Rebel-Queen's prisoner
BackstoryDef.description: Alessia's people had good reason to put an Ayleid to work. [PAWN_nameDef] broke rock for three years for a slave army, and came away with an unusual perspective.

BackstoryDef.title: Sedor sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: Sedor's gardens were guarded better than its vaults. [PAWN_nameDef] once killed a thief for stepping on a rare white lily, and was commended.

BackstoryDef.title: Nenalata's horseman
BackstoryDef.description: Heavy cavalry out of Nenalata had once been a fearsome sight, though there were few left to see it. [PAWN_nameDef] rode with them and still knows the old commands.

BackstoryDef.title: Malada's butcher
BackstoryDef.description: Prisoners at Malada could look forward to a variety of ends. [PAWN_nameDef] was the end you got if the lord happened to be busy that day.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian border captain
BackstoryDef.description: Nedic hill tribes raided the border, and the border was all [PAWN_nameDef] ever knew. Heartland nobles sent new orders and fine wine, and never any men.

BackstoryDef.title: mirror-shield bearer
BackstoryDef.description: Polished shields would reflect magic, or at the very least would blind a peasant. [PAWN_nameDef] stood in the front rank of a parade unit that found itself in a real war.

BackstoryDef.title: Barsaebic marshal
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s lords sided with Alessia's rebels against their own, for reasons of doctrine and also of land. Neither side has really forgiven this.

BackstoryDef.title: slave-army officer
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid lords did not want to fight in person, so they put spears in the hands of their slaves. [PAWN_nameDef] had the job of pointing them the right way, and watching their backs.

BackstoryDef.title: Sancre Tor rearguard
BackstoryDef.description: The Tor was almost impossible to take, until someone opened a door. [PAWN_nameDef] held a corridor there for most of a day, and never did find out who.

BackstoryDef.title: Umaril's herald
BackstoryDef.description: Umaril the Unfeathered had a Daedra lord's backing and needed somebody to read out his terms. [PAWN_nameDef] did this at a number of gates, in a clear and carrying voice.

BackstoryDef.title: war-party scout
BackstoryDef.description: The great Ayleid roads were straight and easy to watch. [PAWN_nameDef] stayed off them and watched from the woods, counting how many came along them and how armed.

BackstoryDef.title: Daedra-handler
BackstoryDef.description: A summoned creature is expensive, and it needs someone to stay by it on the battlefield. [PAWN_nameDef] walked out in front with a whip and a very long list of warnings.

BackstoryDef.title: tower sniper
BackstoryDef.description: Arrow-slits in an Ayleid tower sit at the exact angles of a star chart. [PAWN_nameDef] thought that was stupid until it turned out to put every approach in range.

BackstoryDef.title: road patrol knight
BackstoryDef.description: The road between Vilverin and the Tower had to be kept free of bandits, a term that came to cover a lot of the population. [PAWN_nameDef] rode it for decades.

BackstoryDef.title: last Flower King's guard
BackstoryDef.description: Flower Kings were always followed by someone holding a sword. [PAWN_nameDef] went on following one through three defeats and a long boat journey into exile.

BackstoryDef.title: exile mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: Without a city left to serve, a well-trained Ayleid could still earn. [PAWN_nameDef] sold [PAWN_possessive] sword around Tamriel for centuries and spoke of it to nobody.

BackstoryDef.title: hunting-party master
BackstoryDef.description: Great lords kept a hunting master, and did not always hunt deer. [PAWN_nameDef] ran these parties for a while and then made sure not to dwell on the memory.

BackstoryDef.title: Welkynd priest
BackstoryDef.description: Light fell from Aetherius by way of the stones, and the stones needed proper tending. [PAWN_nameDef] blessed each one and kept a very careful count.

BackstoryDef.title: star-well tender
BackstoryDef.description: Those great wells along the road drank in starlight and gave it out to anybody who knew how. [PAWN_nameDef] walked between six of them for two centuries.

BackstoryDef.title: flesh sculptor
BackstoryDef.description: Lords of the old cities had their slaves reshaped for the sake of an evening's amusement. [PAWN_nameDef] did this work with enormous skill and doesn't think about it often.

BackstoryDef.title: Meridian lightbearer
BackstoryDef.description: Meridia's favor came as a light in the hand, and some of her faithful could use it on undead. [PAWN_nameDef] walked Malada's lower halls and tidied up what was found.

BackstoryDef.title: Molag Bal's confessor
BackstoryDef.description: Heads of certain houses wanted someone who could listen to them and then pass it upward. [PAWN_nameDef] served that purpose, and has a very clear idea of what Molag Bal is.

BackstoryDef.title: elemental binder
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid doctrine holds that Earth, Water, Air and Fire are all four corners of one great chain. [PAWN_nameDef] could call a flame by its proper name, and did so on occasion.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb warden
BackstoryDef.description: Dead Ayleids stay in their tombs, unless someone has a use for them. [PAWN_nameDef] kept a family's ancestors in good order and in decent standing at the door.

BackstoryDef.title: Magna Ge astrologer
BackstoryDef.description: Magnus left through a hole and left others behind him, and they're all up there. [PAWN_nameDef] named a good many of them, and insisted that the charts proved their favor.

BackstoryDef.title: sound-stone singer
BackstoryDef.description: Certain pillars of white stone will ring if addressed in the correct tone. [PAWN_nameDef] sang them awake for feasts, and sometimes for other, less musical reasons.

BackstoryDef.title: poisoner of the court
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid politics are older than most nations, and a bad dinner was a normal part of them. [PAWN_nameDef] served three different families, and outlived all of them.

BackstoryDef.title: necromancer of Vilverin
BackstoryDef.description: Below the water line at Vilverin, certain lords kept their dead working. [PAWN_nameDef] saw to their upkeep and thought the skeletons more reliable than the slaves.

BackstoryDef.title: exile magister
BackstoryDef.description: Arriving at Summerset after the fall, [PAWN_nameDef] expected a welcome as kin. Altmer treated the visitor as an embarrassing relative and asked to see the old texts.

BackstoryDef.title: illusionist of the Heartland
BackstoryDef.description: Halls of Lindai seemed larger with certain lights, and banquets more lavish. [PAWN_nameDef] made sure the lords saw their city as it no longer quite was.

BackstoryDef.title: ward-stone cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Most of the old Ayleid traps are still working, thanks to people like [PAWN_nameDef]. Each glyph was cut to a tolerance no Dwemer would've sneered at.

BackstoryDef.title: court alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: Sedor's flowers go into remedies, perfumes and other things the household preferred not to discuss. [PAWN_nameDef] tended the stills and tested on whoever had displeased.

BackstoryDef.title: Daedric contract-keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Agreements with Daedra Princes run to many pages and don't end when you die. [PAWN_nameDef] kept a great house's contracts and could read the fine print.

BackstoryDef.title: sky reader in exile
BackstoryDef.description: A Star Gallery is hard to build in a Valenwood bog. [PAWN_nameDef] managed something similar with a clearing and some borrowed bones, and the Bosmer were mildly amused.

BackstoryDef.title: master of the feast
BackstoryDef.description: A feast at Lindai served meat from a lot of unusual sources. [PAWN_nameDef] saw to every part of it, and was the only one there sober enough to know what was on the table.

BackstoryDef.title: marble quarry overseer
BackstoryDef.description: White stone came out of the Nibenay hills, and slaves came out in worse condition. [PAWN_nameDef] ran the quarry and sent in the numbers.

BackstoryDef.title: flower merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Rare blooms from Sedor could fetch the price of a horse. [PAWN_nameDef] sold them to lords who gave them to other lords, and was careful to send the right colors.

BackstoryDef.title: household steward
BackstoryDef.description: Great houses employ a single person who knows where everything is, including the bodies. [PAWN_nameDef] served in that role for ninety years and wrote nothing down.

BackstoryDef.title: silver smith
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid tables were set with silver so fine it could be bent by hand. [PAWN_nameDef] made the pieces and got to eat with a horn spoon.

BackstoryDef.title: tribute collector
BackstoryDef.description: Nedic villages paid in grain, cattle and sometimes their children. [PAWN_nameDef] rode out twice a year with a list, and rode back with a very long line.

BackstoryDef.title: stone-road builder
BackstoryDef.description: Those roads are still there, under a great deal of later road. [PAWN_nameDef] cut the first course and was certain it would last, which turned out to be correct.

BackstoryDef.title: garden landscaper
BackstoryDef.description: Whole hillsides were moved to give a lord a better view of the sunset. [PAWN_nameDef] directed the work and got a very nice letter of thanks.

BackstoryDef.title: bathhouse attendant
BackstoryDef.description: The great lords relaxed in the bathhouse, and they talked as if nobody else were there. [PAWN_nameDef] brought the towels and remembered every word of it.

BackstoryDef.title: tapestry dyer
BackstoryDef.description: Star-blue, the deepest color in the Heartland, can only be got from one rare shell. [PAWN_nameDef] had the recipe, and two very unpleasant visitors who wanted it.

BackstoryDef.title: wine steward of Nenalata
BackstoryDef.description: Nenalata's cellars went a long way down, and some of what was stored there was older than the Empire. [PAWN_nameDef] knew each vintage and how to serve it to an enemy.

BackstoryDef.title: slave market auctioneer
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody ever had a better voice for the job, or a stronger stomach. [PAWN_nameDef] worked a market on the Niben that stayed busy until the very last week.

BackstoryDef.title: boat-builder of Rumare
BackstoryDef.description: Slender white boats plied Lake Rumare in great numbers before the fall. [PAWN_nameDef] built them to a design that no one has quite managed to copy.

BackstoryDef.title: gem cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Meteoric glass and star sapphire don't forgive a wrong cut. [PAWN_nameDef] worked by Welkynd light with a very steady hand and rarely spoke.

BackstoryDef.title: court genealogist
BackstoryDef.description: Every Ayleid family traces its line back to the et'Ada, by way of some rather convenient marriages. [PAWN_nameDef] drew the charts and took the money.

BackstoryDef.title: Nedic overseer
BackstoryDef.description: It was unusual for an Ayleid house to hire one of the slaves' own to watch them. [PAWN_nameDef] came to take that as a kind of compliment, at least until the Rebellion.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering relic peddler
BackstoryDef.description: Centuries after the fall, some folk still pay for a real Ayleid trinket. [PAWN_nameDef] sells them and is a bit of a trinket [PAWN_objective]self, if anyone cared to look closely.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin-dwelling hermit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came back to the old city after it had been empty for six hundred years and moved into the smallest room. There were fewer stairs to worry about.

BackstoryDef.title: Bosmer-town tailor
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleid cuts look strange on anyone in Valenwood, but they pay. [PAWN_nameDef] made a modest living in Arenthia sewing elegant robes with hide.

BackstoryDef.title: hidden-court cook
BackstoryDef.description: Dinner for the last of a noble line can be set out with the same care, even if it's boiled root. [PAWN_nameDef] served the last lord in the valley on the last good plate.

BackstoryDef.title: cistern keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Rain for the whole district ran into a vast chamber held up by carved pillars. [PAWN_nameDef] kept it clean and got to know its echoes.

BackstoryDef.title: perfume maker
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in the Heartland wanted to smell like what the slave quarters smelled like. [PAWN_nameDef] sold them a solution, in tiny silver bottles at terrible prices.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb robber
BackstoryDef.description: Sometimes a family goes broke and has to rob its own ancestors. [PAWN_nameDef] went down with a sack and an apologetic manner, and said the correct prayers.

BackstoryDef.title: estate farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Lords like to pretend food arrives by magic, and at some estates it was close. [PAWN_nameDef] oversaw the real thing, with oxen, on the last free land in the valley.

BackstoryDef.title: old language teacher
BackstoryDef.description: Ayleidoon isn't spoken anywhere now, except in a few households and by some Imperial scholars. [PAWN_nameDef] teaches it to those who ask, with very stern corrections.
